credits.title: GROTESQQQUE
credits.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with hef servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

credits.title: Nogizaka46 35thSG Under Live behind the scenes documentary
credits.overview: The behind-the-scenes documentary of "Nogizaka46 35thSG Under Live" will be broadcast exclusively on TV for the first time! A close-up look at the first "Andara" challenged by 4th and 5th generation members!

credits.title: Nogizaka46 “5th Generation” Version Musical “Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon” 2024 「Team STAR」
credits.overview: Sailor Moon musical featuring the 5th Generation members of the idol group, Nogizaka46 where they are playing the Inner Guardians. It ran from April 12th-29th, 2024 and split into two groups for the main Inner Guardian cast, Team Moon and Team Star.

credits.title: Actually...
credits.overview: Aruno Nakanishi is disliked and bullied by the other Nogizaka46 members because she's different from them. After one of them locks Aruno and tells her to not come back, she decides to definitely come back.
